label: Connect your AI: the MCP door's keys, name, limits and words

params.name: key
params.label: MCP keys: how they look, how many may be live

params.name: server

default.instructions: This server works in a ValueStream portal as its owner, for tests and demos: each tool is one of the portal's own buttons - reads look things up, changes press a button. Start with the status tool. A tool marked as a person's step is never done by a tool: its answer says what the person does (signing in, payments, filing elsewhere).

params.label: The server's name and what it tells the AI app

params.name: limits
params.label: Calls per minute per key; most rows in one answer

params.name: parse
params.default: The request is not valid JSON-RPC.
params.label: parse

params.name: bad_key
params.default: This MCP key is unknown or revoked. Make a new one on the Connect your AI screen.
params.label: bad key

params.name: unknown_method
params.default: This server does not offer the method {method}.
params.label: unknown method

params.name: unknown_tool
params.default: There is no tool named {tool}. Ask tools/list for the tools on offer.
params.label: unknown tool

params.name: tool_off
params.default: The tool {tool} is switched off on this server.
params.label: tool off

params.name: not_allowed
params.default: Your account may not use the tool {tool}.
params.label: not allowed

params.name: rate
params.default: Too many calls in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
params.label: rate

params.name: bad_input
params.default: The tool {tool} needs: {need}.
params.label: bad input

params.name: failed
params.default: It could not finish: {why}
params.label: failed

params.name: nothing_found
params.default: Nothing matched "{query}". Try fewer or different words.
params.label: nothing found

params.name: key_limit
params.default: There are already {max} live MCP keys. Revoke one first.
params.label: key limit

params.name: key_missing
params.default: That MCP key does not exist.
params.label: key missing

params.name: key_made
params.default: Key made - copy it now; it is shown only this once.
params.label: key made

params.name: key_revoked
params.default: Key revoked - an AI app using it can no longer connect.
params.label: key revoked

params.name: key_default_label
params.default: My AI app
params.label: key default label

params.name: oauth
params.label: Sign in from the AI app: token shapes and lifetimes

params.name: local_hosts
params.label: This computer: http allowed only here (an AI app's loopback return address)

params.name: check
params.label: What Check asks through the door; how recent a call counts as connected

params.name: poll_seconds
params.label: The screen re-reads the connection status this often while it is open

params.name: sign_in_needed
params.default: Sign in first: add this server in your AI app and press Connect.
params.label: sign in needed

params.name: token_bad
params.default: This sign-in has ended or was disconnected. Connect again in your AI app.
params.label: token bad

params.name: oauth_app_default
params.default: AI app
params.label: oauth app default

params.name: oauth_redirect_rule
params.default: Return addresses must be https, or http on your own computer.
params.label: oauth redirect rule

params.name: oauth_client_unknown
params.default: This AI app is not registered here - add the server again in the app.
params.label: oauth client unknown

params.name: oauth_redirect_bad
params.default: That return address was not registered by this AI app.
params.label: oauth redirect bad

params.name: oauth_response_type
params.default: Only the code flow is offered.
params.label: oauth response type

params.name: oauth_pkce
params.default: The AI app must use PKCE (S256).
params.label: oauth pkce

params.name: oauth_not_allowed
params.default: Your account may not connect AI apps here.
params.label: oauth not allowed

params.name: oauth_code_bad
params.default: That sign-in code is unknown, used or expired - connect again.
params.label: oauth code bad

params.name: oauth_verifier_bad
params.default: The sign-in proof did not match - connect again.
params.label: oauth verifier bad

params.name: oauth_refresh_bad
params.default: This connection has ended - connect again in your AI app.
params.label: oauth refresh bad

params.name: oauth_grant_type
params.default: Unknown grant type.
params.label: oauth grant type

params.name: connection_missing
params.default: That connection does not exist.
params.label: connection missing

params.name: disconnected
params.default: Disconnected - that AI app can no longer look anything up.
params.label: disconnected

params.name: check_init
params.default: The server answers
params.label: check init

params.name: check_list
params.default: It lists {n} {n:tool|tools}
params.label: check list

params.name: check_call
params.default: A tool answers ({tool})
params.label: check call

params.name: check_failed
params.default: Stopped here: {why}
params.label: check failed

params.name: check_ok
params.default: Everything works - an AI app that connects will get answers.
params.label: check ok

params.name: human_step
params.default: {title}: a person does this, never a tool. {say}
params.label: human step
